questions.question: During King Solomon's reign, the prophet Ahijah met Jeroboam alone in a field. What did Ahijah do with his new cloak?

answers.text: Spread it out on the road

questions.question: Through the prophet Ahijah, the LORD said the kingdom would be torn from Solomon's family. What reason did the LORD give?

answers.text: They forsook Him to worship other gods
They refused to finish Jerusalem's wall
They made a treaty with Pharaoh

questions.question: Through the prophet Ahijah, what did the LORD promise Jeroboam, a servant of King Solomon?

answers.text: He would be king over Israel
He would be a prophet like Ahijah
He would be governor over Ephraim

questions.question: When King Solomon tried to kill Jeroboam, what did Jeroboam do?

answers.text: Fled to Shishak king of Egypt
Hid in the hill country of Ephraim
